info.title: Traigent Cloud Best Config Routes
info.description: Backend routes for publishing, fetching, listing, and rolling back promoted runtime best configs.

429.description: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Required when replacing an existing best config. Use the current ETag returned by GET or publish.

parameters.name: X-Traigent-Agent-Ref
parameters.description: Opaque ref of the agent being promoted (the `agent_ref` of the session-create 201). Its presence selects the PROTECTED publish path; sent together with X-Traigent-Expected-Head-Generation. Never a raw agent id.

parameters.name: X-Traigent-Expected-Head-Generation
parameters.description: The head generation the run captured when it STARTED (the `generation` of GET /api/v1/best-configs/agent-heads/by-ref/{agent_ref}). Compare-and-set precondition of the promotion of that run's own result; sent with X-Traigent-Agent-Ref (protected path) or with X-Traigent-Agent-Id (legacy promotion). Never refreshed to cure a stale refusal.

200.description: Existing best config returned or updated

400.description: Protected path: head_capture_invalid or head_body_invalid (closed refusal envelope). Legacy path: its own validation errors, unchanged.

409.description: Publish precondition failed or function_ref conflict (LEGACY path, unchanged), or a PROTECTED-path refusal: head_environment_mismatch, head_agent_mismatch, head_generation_stale or head_publish_conflict (closed envelope; the branches are disjoint, discriminate on the closed `error_code`).

oneOf.x-content-note: LEGACY-path 409 bodies, unchanged (BEST_CONFIG_CONFLICT, STALE_HEAD_GENERATION and other legacy codes); free text by design until the legacy facade is retired. Disjoint from the protected branch: it must not carry a protected closed code.
oneOf.description: Legacy-path 409 bodies, unchanged: publish precondition failures, function_ref conflicts and the STALE_HEAD_GENERATION body of the X-Traigent-Agent-Id promotion. The `not` keeps this branch disjoint from the protected closed refusals.

429.description: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded.

500.description: Protected path: internal_error (closed refusal envelope, fixed text). Legacy path: its own generic error body (BEST_CONFIG_ERROR, "Internal server error"), unchanged. The branches are disjoint, discriminate on the closed `error_code`.

oneOf.x-content-note: LEGACY-path 500 body, unchanged (generic server-error body, e.g. BEST_CONFIG_ERROR); free text by design until the legacy facade is retired. Disjoint from the protected branch: it must not carry the protected closed code.
oneOf.description: Legacy-path 500 body, unchanged. The `not` keeps this branch disjoint from the protected closed internal_error refusal.

post.description: PROTECTED PATH (content-less plan v2.1, phase 0b). APPLICABILITY: a publish is PROTECTED if and only if the request carries X-Traigent-Agent-Ref, or the publish belongs to a session negotiated with content_less_v1 (or content_less_v2 once negotiated); every other publish is the LEGACY path and behaves exactly as before. DECISION TABLE (first matching row; 'session' = the session named in spec.provenance, content-less when its stored shape is content-less): [1] Agent-Ref and Agent-Id both present -> 400 head_capture_invalid. [2] Agent-Ref present, Expected-Head-Generation missing or not an integer 0..2^53-1 -> 400 head_capture_invalid. [3] Agent-Ref malformed (not agentref_<32 hex>) -> 400 head_capture_invalid. [4] Agent-Ref present but no resolvable content-less session binding -> 400 head_capture_invalid. [5] Agent-Ref and a valid Expected-Head-Generation, content-less session -> PROTECTED (below). [6] No Agent-Ref, content-less session (with or without Agent-Id / Expected-Head-Generation) -> 400 head_capture_invalid (the capture is required). [7] No Agent-Ref, non-content-less or no session, Agent-Id and/or Expected-Head-Generation -> LEGACY, unchanged (including the legacy Agent-Id promotion and its STALE_HEAD_GENERATION 409 and its own validation errors). [8] No Agent-Ref, no capture headers, non-content-less or no session -> LEGACY, unchanged. PROTECTED RULE: the Backend resolves agent, run and environment from the authoritative session binding, never from the body; keeps agent WRITE authorization; and refuses with a closed code (best_config_head_refusal_schema.json), with no publication row and no head change. ORDER OF REFUSALS: malformed or incomplete capture 400 head_capture_invalid; well-formed but unknown or foreign ref 404 reference_not_found (nothing echoed); agent WRITE denied 403 head_write_unauthorized; ref's agent is not the session's 409 head_agent_mismatch; publish environment differs from the session's 409 head_environment_mismatch; body fails validation 400 head_body_invalid (fixed text, no key or value of the request echoed); head moved 409 head_generation_stale; ordinary publish conflict (If-Match on a new configuration, a changed existing configuration without a matching If-Match, function_ref conflict) 409 head_publish_conflict; any other server-side failure 500 internal_error. A protected request never receives the generic BEST_CONFIG_CONFLICT or a free-text validation body. STALE: the run's result is stale; the client MUST NOT refresh the generation and resubmit the same result, and the SDK MUST NEVER auto-retry a stale refusal (it starts a new run, or re-evaluates against the new head, and publishes with that run's own captured generation). Publish and promote are ONE transaction: a refused or failed promotion leaves no visible configuration version; the head moves g -> g+1 (first promotion 0 -> 1) atomically with the publication, and of several concurrent promotions naming the same expected generation exactly one wins.
